Recharts depends on browser DOM/SVG and is unavailable in React Native; the native charts barrel renders each chart primitive as an explicit, accessible native-safe 'unavailable' placeholder while preserving the full data flow, unit handling, i18n keys, panel structure and empty states. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only react, react-native primitives, the native web-parity charts barrel, and existing apps/native MetricCard / SemanticIcon / AppText / GlassPanel / theme tokens.
